Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

7. Sampling — Sampling and criteria for acceptance shall be in accordance with 18:7778-1975 
' Methods for sampling small tools '. 

8. Designation— A carbide tipped Morse taper shank twist drill with 14*0 mm diameter, for right- 
hand cutting, having carbide tip of range of application K20 and conforming to this standard shall be 
designated as: 

Carbide Tipped Twist Drill 140 IS : 8306 

8.1 If a twist drill with carbide tip of range of application other than K20 is required, the range of 
application may be indicated in the designation immediately after the number of Indian Standard. 

9. Marking --* Each drill shall be marked with its diameter d, range of application of the carbide tip, 
and the manufacturer's name or trade-mark. The marking shall be so applied and finished that it does 
not interfere with the secure holding of the drill. 

10. Protective Coating and Packing 

10.1 Each twist drill shall be covered with a suitable rust-proofing material. 

10.2 Each twist drill or a number of drills shall be wrapped in a non-absorbent paper protected by a cover 
bearing the size, range of application of the carbide tip, and the manufacturer's name or trade-mark. 

10.3 Twist drills of only one size shall be packed in one carton. 



EXPLANATORY NQTE 

In ti^e preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from DIN 8041 ' Spiralbohrer 
mit Morsekegel mit Schneidplatte aus Hartmetall fiir Metall' ( Twist drills with Morse taper shank with 
carbide tips for drilling metal ), August 1971, issued by Deutsches Institutfiir Normung.
